# Isaiah Chapter 18 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 7 verses]*

*Land of whirring wings; swift messengers; God watching; future tribute from Cush*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth. This chapter land of whirring wings.

*-- LOGOS*
